title: Kioxia Introduces Flash-for-DRAM Initiative for AI Workloads
summary: Kioxia announced a CXL-attached memory expansion utilizing NAND flash optimized for high-speed processing alongside AI compute devices.

title: New Solid-State Cooler Uses Heat to Generate Cold
summary: Scientists developed a solid-state cooling device that uses heat to generate cold, potentially recycling waste heat from electronics.

title: LightMake L4 3D Printer Features Four Independent Print Heads
summary: The LightMake L4 desktop 3D printer launches on Kickstarter with four independent print heads to address speed, multi-color waste, and volume constraints.

title: NASA Funds Slingshot Spacecraft Concept for Mineral Mapping
summary: NASA is funding an early-stage concept to test new techniques for mapping minerals on planetary bodies across the solar system.

title: Blue Origin Expands Cape Facilities
summary: Blue Origin is expanding its test and launch footprints at the Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral.

title: iSpace to Lead ESA Lunar Polar Ice Rover Mission
summary: iSpace-Europe and ESA agreed on the MAGPIE mission, which is Europe’s first lunar polar ice exploration rover.

title: UK Military Tests Powered Paragliders
summary: The British Ministry of Defence is evaluating foot-launched powered paragliders for covert troop insertion and reconnaissance.
